_about: The one place to change colours, fonts and logos. Tools read it through brand/brand.py. The college here is fictional.

brand_blue.use: the logo, and the one colour in guides and plans

coral.use: small signals only, such as the dot on email banners

muted.use: quiet text and lines on ink

display.use: headlines, big numbers, short labels in capitals

fonts.licence: Barlow Condensed and DM Sans are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, see fonts/OFL.txt.

style_rules: Ink, paper and brand blue carry the design. No extra colours.
Guides and plans: white page, one blue, thin grey table lines, no tinted boxes.
Few labels. Each fact said once. No filler lines.
Photos light and clean, never dark.
Email banners: 1200 x 400, shown at 600 x 200. The first frame is the finished picture.
Dates, place and links are always in the email text too, never only in a picture.
